User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the Decimal Conquest game.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity.

countryId.description: Reference to the Country this user belongs to.

Country.title: Country
Country.description: Represents a country created by a user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Country entity.

createdBy.description: The UID of the user who created the country.

color.description: The HEX or HSL color string for the country.

LandTile.title: LandTile
LandTile.description: Represents a single land tile on the game map.

id.description: Unique identifier for the LandTile entity.

x.description: X-coordinate of the land tile on the map.

y.description: Y-coordinate of the land tile on the map.

ownerId.description: Reference to the User who owns this land tile. (Relationship: User 1:N LandTile)

ProblemAttempt.title: ProblemAttempt
ProblemAttempt.description: Represents a user's attempt at solving a math problem.

WrongAnswer.title: WrongAnswer
WrongAnswer.description: Stores problems that a user answered incorrectly.

definition.description: Stores user profiles. Any authenticated user can read for game state, but only the user can modify their own profile.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user.

definition.description: Stores incorrect problems for a specific user to review. Only accessible by that user.

params.name: wrongAnswerId
params.description: The unique ID for the wrong answer entry.

definition.description: Stores all countries created by users. Accessible to all authenticated users.

params.name: countryId
params.description: The unique identifier of the country.

definition.description: Stores all land tiles on the game map. Accessible to all authenticated users for gameplay.

params.name: landTileId
params.description: The unique identifier of the land tile.

definition.description: Stores each attempt a user makes on a problem for analytics. Only the user can create and list their own attempts.

params.name: attemptId
params.description: The unique ID for the attempt.
